title: The same anatomy is conscious or not depending on its processes

statements.text: The structure of the thalamocortical system does not change in deep sleep or anesthesia, yet consciousness disappears, and local sensory responses can stay the same. Consciousness therefore relies on specific neural processes that differ between conscious and unconscious brains.

sources.quote: the structure of the thalamocortical system does not change when we are in deep sleep or undergo anesthesia, yet consciousness disappears
